description: Growth Lab - Theme-driven B2B SaaS marketing engine for ServiceSnapp.

userStories.title: Growth Lab Database Schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store campaign themes, ideas, and outreach opportunities.
acceptanceCriteria: Create growth_settings table (user_id, current_theme, updated_at)
Create growth_concepts table (id, topic, theme_snapshot, status)
Create growth_posts table (id, concept_id, platform, content)
Create engagement_opportunities table (id, user_id, query_url, suggested_reply, status)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Weekly Theme Logic & Nixing
userStories.description: As a user, I want the AI to suggest a weekly strategic theme that I can approve or replace.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement generateWeeklyTheme() in geminiService
UI allows user to trigger a re-suggest (nix current theme)
Theme is persisted to growth_settings
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Campaign-Aligned Daily Sparks
userStories.description: As a user, I want 3-4 raw marketing ideas daily that align with my weekly theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement generateDailySparks(activeTheme) in crmService
Prompts ensure alignment with the Weekly Theme and B2B SaaS persona
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Idea Triage Dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see raw ideas as cards and decide which to 'Kill' or 'Ignite'.
acceptanceCriteria: Build GrowthIdeation component
Kill action archives the concept
Ignite action moves concept to the Forge stage
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Platform Expansion (The Forge)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate platform-specific post kits once an idea is ignited.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement expandConcept(conceptId, platform) for LinkedIn and X
LinkedIn content is professional/long-form; X content is punchy/thread-ready
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Post Kit UI & Clipboard Actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to review my forge kits and copy them to my clipboard.
acceptanceCriteria: UI displays generated posts for the selected platform
Copy to Clipboard button works for text and hashtags
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Outreach Search Link Generator (The Pulse)
userStories.description: As a user, I want pre-filled search links for Reddit/X based on my active theme.
acceptanceCriteria: AI generates query_url matching theme-related pain points
Search links open in new tabs
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Value-First Reply Templates
userStories.description: As a user, I want suggested replies for outreach that don't sound like spam.
acceptanceCriteria: AI generates 3 distinct 'human-first' replies for each opportunity
Templates prioritize solving the user's problem over pitching the product
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Outreach Tracking UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to track which outreach opportunities I have completed.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist interface for engagement opportunities
Marking 'Done' increments the reply counter metric
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Growth Lab Routing & Layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated section of the app to manage my growth experiments.
acceptanceCriteria: Add /growth-lab route
Sidebar/Navigation includes Growth Lab link
Dashboard shows weekly theme and key metrics
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented and verified. Navigation and routing are fully functional.
